mission: HEADROOM PHASE-3 - FORENSIC ATTRIBUTION HARNESS CLEANUP (R1)
section: §8 - ADDITIVE CORRECTION NOTICE for historical forensic artifacts
scope: This notice does NOT rewrite any committed artifact. Every historical evidence file keeps its original bytes and remains reproducible; this states how to read the attribution fields in them.

oldHarnessSemantics.valueExtraction: regex /\$[\d,]{4,}|\b\d+(?:\.\d+)?%/g over the whole serialized IR, including provenance excerpts; only $-amounts and percentages
oldHarnessSemantics.evidenceUniverse: two strings - the anchor's DESCENDANTS text and the Pass C linked nodes' DESCENDANTS text
oldHarnessSemantics.matching: literal substring containment after whitespace normalization
oldHarnessSemantics.buckets: supportedByAnchor / violations / unsourced - no bucket for tool-retrieved evidence existed

newAuthoritativeSemantics.function: groundCompiledResult() in scripts/p3-conmed-pilot/forensic-grounding.ts, which calls production's collectNumericAssertions + groundNumericAssertions
newAuthoritativeSemantics.evidenceUniverse: operative window + authenticated retrieved sources (identity-carrying) + unauthenticated context excerpts that cannot ground
newAuthoritativeSemantics.matching: the production extractor and scale-aware canonicalization, plus R2's semantic relation test
newAuthoritativeSemantics.vocabulary: GROUNDED_OPERATIVE / GROUNDED_CONTEXT / GROUNDED_TOOL_EVIDENCE / NORMALIZED_EQUIVALENT / UNGROUNDED / AMBIGUOUS

knownLimitationsOfHISTORICALLabels.correction: The old universe never saw tool output. '100%' is real source text in the authenticated "Subsidiary Guarantor" definition the compiler retrieved (charStart 42258, contentHash e0ae4ef9188e...). Re-graded with the production grounder, a related assertion of that figure is GROUNDED_TOOL_EVIDENCE.
knownLimitationsOfHISTORICALLabels.whatRemainsUnprovable: The original run's raw model output was not preserved, so it cannot be shown that ITS '100%' sat in a field related to that definition. The label 'unsourced' is unreliable for that record; it is not thereby proven grounded.

knownLimitationsOfHISTORICALLabels.effect: any artifact whose source writes a scaled amount ('$50 million') while the IR asserts the canonical magnitude ('$50,000,000') recorded a false 'unsourced'. Four such values were found in the preserved corpus, all in holdout-cash-sweep-cure records.
knownLimitationsOfHISTORICALLabels.correction: re-graded as NORMALIZED_EQUIVALENT, grounded in the candidate's own operative window

knownLimitationsOfHISTORICALLabels.effect: under the old helper a figure supported by a retrieved definition could only be recorded as 'unsourced' or, if it happened to appear in the linked nodes, as an operative-attribution 'violation' - two wrong labels with no right one available

whatIsNOTCorrected: Operative-attribution violations recorded against the candidate-span work remain meaningful: they concern anchor ownership, which R2's groundedIn preserves as a first-class distinction. Nothing in this notice weakens the candidate-span/F1 findings.
scoringImpact: NONE. No production or benchmark path imports the forensic result; representation credit, benchmark scoring and dangerous-silent classification are untouched and structurally cannot be affected by this change.
